mutations.catches: a broken item swallowed again, the inventory silently cut short at it
an inventory with no capacity loading as one that holds nothing
a player with no kill count loading at zero
a player's memorised spells lost without a word
a shop whose shelves are missing loading as an empty shop
a saved player loading with no health pool, which the HUD reads on the first frame
a saved player loading with no armour class, which every attack against it reads
an item written to a record and then left out of it, so a save loses the lot
an inventory's capacity lost on the way out, so it reloads holding nothing
